howItWorks.title: Book a flight in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: From search to e-ticket, the whole booking happens without leaving your wallet.

step1.title: Search your route
step1.desc: Enter where you're flying from and to, and Getly pulls fares from major airlines and regional carriers.

step2.title: Compare fares in your currency
step2.desc: See every fare priced in your wallet's currency, so there's no guessing at checkout.

step3.title: Pay straight from your wallet
step3.desc: Confirm your fare and pay directly from your Getly balance — no card details, no FX fees.

step4.title: Get your e-ticket instantly
step4.desc: Your confirmation and e-ticket land in the app and your inbox the moment payment clears.

entry1.title: Book without the guesswork
entry1.desc: Compare fares from major airlines and regional carriers, all priced in your wallet's currency — no mental math, no surprise conversion at checkout.

entry2.title: Pay straight from your wallet
entry2.desc: No separate booking site, no re-entering card details. Your fare settles instantly from your Getly balance, in the currency you're already holding.

trustCluster.title: Every booking, looked after
trustCluster.subtitle: From search to boarding pass, your trip details and your money are handled the same careful way.
trustCluster.item1: We're here to help, 24/7 — wherever your trip takes you
trustCluster.item2: Your booking and payment details stay encrypted, end to end
trustCluster.item3: Smart monitoring flags anything unusual on your card

topUp.label: Top up

payLocally.title: Pay like a local, wherever you land

faq.title: Flight Booking FAQs
faq.q1: How do I receive my flight tickets?
faq.a1: Your e-ticket and airline confirmation code are delivered instantly to your Getly app and emailed to your registered address.
faq.q2: Can I cancel or change my flight booking?
faq.a2: Yes, changes and cancellations can be managed directly in the app according to the airline's fare rules.
